svg.font-family: "Segoe UI","Helvetica Neue","Liberation Sans",Arial,sans-serif,"Hiragino Sans","Noto Sans JP","Yu Gothic","Meiryo","IPAPGothic",sans-serif
svg.title: Supply voltage waveform during a motor start, with the derived RMS
svg.desc: Instantaneous voltage sampled at 3,200 samples per second (64 per 50 Hz cycle) over 300 ms. The one-cycle RMS, refreshed every half cycle, falls to 145 V (63% of 230 V) and stays below the 90% threshold for 110 ms. The RMS line is computed from the same samples.
svg.text: Time (ms), sampled 3,200 times per second, 64 per cycle
